name: Scale of Souls' REST: return a card from your memory to your hand
notes: Field-resident REGALIA/ITEM cards whose activated ability is registered in $cardActivatedAbilities had no client-reachable activation path (CustomInput.php's "myField"/"myIntent" case only ever called ActivateAbility(), which reads a different dictionary) -- fixed by routing through ActivateCard() when CardCardActivatedCount() indicates this dictionary instead. This fixture confirms the fix end-to-end: a direct myField-N!CustomInput!Activate:0 click now correctly resolves Scale of Souls' REST ability, returning the chosen memory card to hand.

rulesClauses: (2), REST: Return a card from your memory to your hand.
